services.name: Art Classes
services.desc: Adults and teens of all skill levels are invited to explore their creativity through inspiring visual arts classes led by studio artist, muralist, and book illustrator Peggy Grinvalsky. Known for her relaxed teaching style, Peggy helps students learn to draw what they see, develop a lively sense of color, and experiment with bold vitality. Tuesday mornings 10 am - Noon $225. Teens/Adults, All Levels. No experience necessary. Choose your medium, direction of interest. Tuesday evenings 6 pm - 8 pm $225. Teens/Adults, All Levels. No experience necessary. Choose your medium, direction of interest. Thursday mornings 10 am - Noon $225. Beginners and those who want to take it slow. No experience
